Messages.Author: Meej
Messages.Body:
On Apr 18, 12:50 pm, The Name Forgotten <tex...@telkomsa.net> wrote:

> Could get quite ridiculous after a while. Of course the chances of a
> deck running like this is very slim indeed. Still, it's always seemed
> a little strange to me that not only can you tempt your own vampires,
> but you can do it more than once in a round.

I'm pretty certain you can only use a given Temptation once per round.

Temptation [AH:R2, FN:PS, KMW:PB, LotN:PS3]
Cardtype: 	Action
Cost: 	1 blood
Discipline: 	Serpentis
[ser] (D) Put this card on a ready vampire; you still control this
card.
During your master phase, you may put a counter on this card. During
your minion phase, if the number of counters on this card equals or
exceeds the amount of blood on this vampire, you may burn the
counters to untap this vampire and take control of him or her until
the
end of the turn.
[SER] As above, and add a counter when you play this card.

"During your minion phase..., you may..." implies once per minion
phase.

You can do this sort of thing, but it requires one copy of Temptation
per untap.

- D.J.

Might I suggest a slightly less card intensive, permanent-focused
version
It leaves room for offensive cards (I recommend a 60-75 card deck
for this one).

Base module.
Hesha Ruhadze = 2 stealth hunt for 2 with [SER]
Aaron's Feeding Razor = 2 stealth hunt for 3
Into the Fire + Hungry Coyote = 2 stealth hunt for 4
Sunset Strip Hollywood = 3 steath hunt for 4.
Harvest Rites = 1shot +1hunt
Perfectionist = 1shot +1hunt
Communal Haven, Temple = move blood at start of turn
Heidleburg Castle = move blood during turn

Mostly repeatable, as many times as you put Temptation on Hesha.

Add [pre] bleed with [obf] stealth.  There are also 5 other
G2/3 vampires of cap < 6 who have [pre][obf].
One of even helps get the Feeding Razor in play.

Pack a bunch of both Vessels and Blood Dolls, as you'll
be pulling pool like mad from numerous sources even without
resorting to in-turn raves (remember, Temple is not unique,
so you'll be shuffling a lot of blood during your untap)

I also recommend Secure Haven.  Hesha is a huge rush target
when he has multiple Temptations, Vessels and Dolls.
